enable: Scale marker area by observation count
label: Count meaning / legend title
help: Each marker's area equals its count multiplied by this scale. Shape changes preserve area. Reduce the scale for large counts. Counts must be non-negative integers; zero has no marker.
countInvalid: Observation counts must be non-negative safe integers.
needScale: Declare a marker area scale for the mapped observation counts.
invalid: Give the count a label and a positive area scale no greater than 65,536.
range: Count-sized markers require a line or scatter plot, a count for every measurement, and area no greater than 65,536 square SVG units. Reduce the area scale for large counts.
mapping: Count columns apply to individual measurements and must contain exact non-negative integers.
